title: .agents/learn/index.json
description: Lightweight index of every learning known to the project. Full detail (evidence, justification, diff) lives in learnings/<id>.md; this file exists so search/audit/apply don't have to parse every markdown file.

schema_version.description: Bump only when the shape of a learning record changes incompatibly. See references/rollback-and-migration.md#migracao.

id.description: Allocated by scripts/learn_id.py. Monotonic, gaps allowed.

version.description: MAJOR.MINOR.REVISION. Initial value set by the decision matrix, see references/id-and-versioning.md.

target_file.description: Path (relative to project root, or ~/.codex/AGENTS.md for global scope) that learn_apply.py patches.

occurrences.description: How many independent sessions/pieces of evidence support this learning so far.

last_used.description: Last time this learning was observed to actually change agent behavior, not just exist.

last_validated.description: Last time a human or a $learn audit pass confirmed this is still accurate.

related_technology.description: e.g. ["nextjs", "prisma"] -- used to flag obsolescence when a dependency is removed.
